sub_theme_notes: Biotech: dispersion is the signal. Large pharma is up (+12pp vs SPY over 3m, 89% breadth) but fading over 1m; AI health and diagnostics is accelerating; GLP-1 is improving on price while the corpus cools on it (NVO -21% in a month); SMID biotech and gene editing are fading; psychedelics are lagging. Prefer cash-generating large caps and diagnostics with revenue over pre-revenue SMID in a 2.8% real-yield world.

Semis: the 3-month drawdown was led by equipment (-24pp vs SPY) and memory (-24pp), but over one month memory, compute and CPUs have turned up while semicap still lags. The cycle is now in pricing (memory), not in capex (tools). Networking and optics (CRDO -13.5% in a month) are lagging despite product news.
